Type: cabinet
Name: Rockpoint Bisenzio 58-Inch Floating Wall-Mounted TV Stand, Pure White
Wall-mounted floating TV stand offers an off-the-floor design; accommodates a flat-screen TV up to 60 inches and up to 75 pounds 3 compartments for audio/video components; lower shelf for media—holds up to 137 Blu-Ray discs or 93 CDs or DVDs Cable-management pathways conceal cords for a modern, minimalist appearance Made of composite wood with a clean white finish; metal hanging rail system for easily wall-mounting the unit (at any height) Measures 58 inches wide; simple assembly required
